newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks close marginally higher.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks close marginally higher.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed with marginal gains on the back of buying by local and foreign investors, brokers said.
Bogota's IBB index closed up a tiny 0.01 percent at 873.93 on a trading volume of 1.2 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED index rose 0.17 percent to 13,516.41 on trading volume of 1.9 billion pesos.
"Today was a buyers' market and shares were freely on offer to foreign investment funds and domestic investors," one Bogota broker said.
"Both operations were cross deals between shareholders and were carried out by the same brokerage, " one dealer said.

The Medellin exchange was very quiet and the slight rise in the index was due to the two deals mentioned and a third involving 453.7 million pesos in fuel distributor Terpel Centro shares, which ended at 325.68 pesos, up 0.21 percent.
That was the reason why share prices for the brewer's Bavaria and Banco Ganadero showed no fluctuation on the Bogota exchange, he explained.

Bavaria stayed stable at 3,900 pesos per share on a trading volume of 631.2 million pesos and Banco Ganadero remained at 283 on a volume of 323.5 million pesos. Trading in these two shares made up 70 percent of the total in Bogota.

In Medellin, Banco Industrial Colombiano dominated trading with a volume of 477 million pesos. It closed up 0.99 percent at 3,565 pesos, while shares in food manufacturer Industrias Noel ended steady at 2,750 pesos on 565.2 million pesos traded.
